title: A.B.E. Doctrine Map
description: Structured doctrine map for the A.B.E. authority layer. These doctrines anchor the constitutional logic used across validation, invalidity, recovery, and integration layers.

engine_relationship.rule: Doctrines anchor and condition the engine. They do not replace or reorder the pioneer spine.

categories.name: Constitutional Alignment
categories.description: Doctrines that define baseline constitutional fidelity and lawful alignment.

categories.name: Invalidity / Nullity
categories.description: Doctrines that define when acts or doctrines are void from inception.

categories.name: Restoration / Realignment
categories.description: Doctrines that connect constitutional divergence to corrective recovery and realignment.

doctrines.name: Constitutional Fidelity
doctrines.abe_role: Defines the baseline alignment condition for lawful authority, delegated power, and structural legitimacy.
summary_points: Constitutional text and delegated authority are the primary alignment baseline.
Administrative or judicial drift cannot displace constitutional supremacy.

doctrines.name: Void ab Initio
doctrines.abe_role: Defines when actions, doctrines, or enforcement postures are void from the beginning and incapable of generating lawful downstream authority.
summary_points: An invalid source cannot generate valid downstream authority.
Ultra vires action cannot be repaired by repetition or habit.
Nullity is structural, not merely procedural.

doctrines.name: ABE — Citizens’ Rights Restoration Act (CRRA)
doctrines.abe_role: Defines the restoration pathway linking constitutional divergence to measurable recovery, funding integrity, and public realignment.
summary_points: Recovery is measurable and tied to realignment.
Funding integrity is part of restoration, not an afterthought.
Restoration is structural, civic, and economic.
